correctness.rationale: For every D,r>0, every reset law supported on a genuine [a,b] subset of (0,∞), and m>b, the killed Brownian two-boundary Dirichlet probabilities A_m and B_m are explicitly solved. Geometric summation gives the conditional first-hit origin mark μ_up independent of m. The Laplace first-hit probability e^{-κx} gives terminal absorption mark μ_down. Strong Markov at first m-hit and memorylessness yield an exact e^{-κm} same-origin component and an independent fresh-reset μ_up×μ_down component. Expansion proves the covariance and total-variation bounds; strict monotone likelihood ratio follows from e^{κx}sinh κx increasing. One-sided Laplace asymptotics prove the opposite independent Gamma endpoint layers under stated positive power-law densities. The standalone checker passed 26 finite numerical/discrete-model assertions. The proof does not infer any infinite-dimensional result from those tests.

originality.rationale: Closest primary papers give general random reset-location first-passage times (Toledo-Marín–Boyer 2022; Méndez et al. 2024) or unmarked maximum laws for a fixed site (Guo et al. 2023). A closely related 2026 public result already provides an all-threshold unmarked maximum exceedance envelope for arbitrary reset distributions. The current claim is not that scalar result: it is the complete conditional joint law of first barrier-crossing excursion origin and last absorbing excursion origin, with threshold-independent upper tilt, exact e^{-κm} diagonal dependence, strict lower-versus-upper mark order, and independent opposite-endpoint Gamma layers. The inspected sources did not state the two marked conditional variables or their joint measure. The new statement needs a post-first-hit strong-Markov decomposition in addition to the known boundary/renewal formulas. General marked-renewal or unindexed literature may have stronger coverage; independent priority remains open.
residual_risks: Unindexed literature on marked renewal excursions or path-decomposition under spatial resetting could establish an equivalent joint law or stronger general Markov-reset theorem.

The exact marked formula uses standard strong-Markov and renewal techniques, and specialists may regard the extension from a known scalar exceedance formula as immediate; independent assessment of priority and research value is still required.
Published 2026 unmarked maximum and distributed-reset results share the model and several proof ingredients; they are explicitly acknowledged and not claimed as new.
The endpoint density asymptotics are not valid for arbitrary singular reset laws; only unscaled endpoint selection is claimed in that case.

value.rationale: The first threshold-reaching excursion and the terminal absorbing excursion are two physically meaningful marked events whose origins distinguish sources of dangerous spatial excursions from effective target capture. The exact conditional joint measure, universal threshold independence of extreme-origin selection, all-rate likelihood-ratio order, exponentially small origin covariance and independent opposite Gamma endpoint layers quantify this separation for all compact i.i.d. reset-position laws, not isolated parameter points. Scalar first-passage times and maximum probabilities cannot by themselves describe the two origins, and the values provide testable sampling predictions for heterogeneous spatial resetting. No paper-sized contribution or downstream general theorem is claimed.
